values: A vertex maximum principle for subcritical reinforcement; Alec Kriebel; version 1.0; preprint date 2026-10-13; problem 30005453; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/764. The literal nonnegative-equilibrium uniqueness assertion is false. The accepted positive-equilibrium theorem is an explicitly corrected formulation: unique strictly positive equilibrium and simultaneous almost-sure coordinatewise homogenization for countable undirected simple bounded-degree graphs, positive bounded-above rates with infimum possibly zero,0<=alpha<1,and unit or finite deterministic positive integer initial counts. It is presented as a credited alternative proof of the positive homogenization result, not as a proof of unrestricted nonnegative uniqueness or a new theorem. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof verification. Qin arXiv:2610.11780v1 (submitted 8 October 2026) already supplies the full positive theorem and broader real initialization; this note presents a different proof recorded in PR764, whose server creation date is 5 October. Older matching equilibria and partial results are credited. Angel-Hermon-Yao work is reported by Qin but its full manuscript and public date were not verified. Neither first historical priority nor the first public availability of current proof bytes is certified. Deposit includes PDF and source/verification archive.
